models_evaluated: in-house deep learning auto-segmentation model for brain organs at risk

links.outcome: Expert-rated clinical acceptability of auto-segmented brain organ-at-risk contours
links.effect: 88% of automatically segmented structures were clinically acceptable with only minor adjustments needed; the remainder needed more than minor adjustment.
links.quote: Expert evaluation revealed that 88% of automatically segmented structures were clinically acceptable with only minor adjustments needed.

unlisted_practices: Multifaceted technical evaluation framework combining geometric measures, expert qualitative rating, time-efficiency analysis and dosimetric impact analysis for auto-segmentation models
Multi-institution expert panel evaluation of auto-segmentation contours
Dosimetric impact assessment of AI-generated contours on treatment plans

screen.reason: Empirically tests and demonstrates a multifaceted validation framework (expert qualitative evaluation, time-efficiency, geometric, and dosimetric impact) for validating auto-segmentation models prior to clinical adoption.

primary.practice: multifaceted clinical validation framework before implementation
